name: Midnight Matinee
thesis: A pocket theatre: writing is backstage intimacy and a complete human-made poem is the shared performance. Exploration only, not a selected production identity.

type.source: Locally bundled SIL OFL families; Georgia and sans-serif fallbacks
type.alignment: Left-aligned poem and practical text; centered stage object, never centered verse

principles: One original arch/curtain metaphor carries identity in grayscale; no casino accents, neon, grain, repeated gold borders or uniform dashboard cards.
Human names and literal actions outrank stage language. No one must perform an identity or read aloud; an available human can step in.
Quiet writing, complete stable reading. The only animated aperture belongs to a deliberate completed-poem reveal.
Sound defaults off, haptics are omitted, OS reduced motion and an additional explicit reduce override both remove decorative motion.

Before coding, the plan compared a gilded theatre poster with an intimate pocket playbill. Critique rejected the gilded option as formal and status-oriented; the retained arch uses plain paper, sentence-case controls and dark ink on gold.
Every standalone scene is labelled a disconnected design sketch. Synthetic sample cast and poems are never claimed as live gameplay or backend evidence.
workflow: Home → host or invited/manual join form → named cast lobby with a clear invitation.
Start local sketch → nine human-typed rounds of 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 words, only the previous entry visible → immediately available recorded receipt → deliberate next round.
After the ninth accepted line, open one complete poem → optional human reader handoff or step-in → private recap.
Replay the whole poem, start another sketch, return to lobby or exit. Private keep, local image save and print never imply public linking.
Public poem and whole-recap publication are separately disclosed, explicitly simulated local states with cancellation/error/revocation; no backend or external asset calls.
tradeoffs: The theatre metaphor provides a strong shared-screen composition, but a named reader can increase social pressure. Keep step-in and Done visible, avoid a moving spotlight, and never force sound or dramatic delay.
A single 340ms movement is confined to ten-pixel curtain edges. Every line is readable from first paint, even if animation is suspended; reduced motion removes the edge movement entirely.
Dark plum is intimate but could read premium or casino-like. The intentional lavender daylight mode, ordinary language and gold-only action/ticket restraint counter that risk.
Cameos aid grayscale recognition but are optional; pen names remain the sole necessary identity.
The current favorite-leader crown is deliberately not carried into this proposal: a private Keep control avoids scoring the group’s writing.

No browser, runtime, accessibility or deployment claims are made by this authoring pass; Main owns rendered verification. QR encodes an explicitly harmless sketch text; account and publication states are disconnected treatments, not live integrations.

views.composition: One persistent pocket-theatre portal with the curtain-line mark, quiet utilities and a separate sketch-provenance rail.
views.hierarchy: People and the next action precede account tools. Compact game chrome keeps recovery reachable.
views.interaction: Home, collection, help and appearance have labelled controls; dialogs return focus to the invoking control.
views.mobile: Utilities wrap in normal flow. No fixed toolbar covers the keyboard.
views.motion: Routine navigation is immediate; no theatrical entrance for utility pages.
views.copy: A little room for unexpected poems.

views.composition: A large left-aligned invitation faces one original open-curtain illustration; the literal nine-count arc follows the entry actions.
views.hierarchy: Create a room and Join a room are the two dominant actions. Human collaboration precedes account benefits.
views.interaction: Both paths open a focused name form. How to play is optional and never blocks entry.
views.mobile: A compact three-line invitation keeps both entry actions in the first phone viewport; the smaller still illustration follows. Buttons wrap at large text sizes.
views.motion: The illustration stays still. The sole expressive aperture belongs to a completed poem.
views.copy: A little room. An unexpected poem.

views.composition: One intimate arch contains the name form and optional cameo disclosure, without a settings questionnaire.
views.hierarchy: Name, Create sketch room, then honest guest and local-data context.
views.interaction: Empty names show inline recovery; pending and error keep the entered name and nearby submit action.
views.mobile: Name and action share the same scroll surface; no arrival autofocus or keyboard-covering footer.
views.motion: No form entrance, fake spinner or identity ceremony.
views.copy: Bring a name. The room is yours to start.

views.composition: The same quiet name stage begins with a clearly identified manual or invited destination.
views.hierarchy: Room code and ordinary human name precede all optional customization.
views.interaction: Code Enter moves to name; invited code is read-only and explained. SKETCH is a labelled non-live token, never a real room code.
views.mobile: Stacked labelled fields retain long names, invitation context and recovery text.
views.motion: Pending updates in place; no stamped-code theatrics.
views.copy: There is a place for you.

views.composition: A named cast strip tops one arch stage, paired with a single perforated gold invitation ticket.
views.hierarchy: Invitation, present humans and the host start action form the hierarchy; room tools stay disclosed.
views.interaction: Host and participant controls differ. One-person start is unavailable; full, away and error states keep name and ownership clear.
views.mobile: The invitation stacks before the stage; the cast wraps into visible rows so no person's presence depends on discovering a sideways scroll.
views.motion: One cameo may settle on arrival, never delayed or staggered human names.
views.copy: The cast is gathering. Everyone gets a turn.

views.composition: An enlarged invitation ticket and the same named cast form a readable shared-screen playbill.
views.hierarchy: Room destination, complete roster and permanent Exit presentation; no TV-only dependency.
views.interaction: Open invitation returns to the local join sketch. The original QR specimen encodes only LINEJAM DESIGN SKETCH, not a live destination.
views.mobile: Ticket and roster stack at narrow widths, preserving the same hierarchy.
views.motion: One short cameo settle and a textual arrival label; no stage flash.
views.copy: A place for everyone.

views.composition: One previous line and one generous textarea sit left aligned within a quiet arch; the cast retires to compact chrome.
views.hierarchy: Required word count, carried line, current input, nearby count and Submit line.
views.interaction: The core path requires nine human-typed entries of 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 words; only the previous entry is exposed. Paste normalizes whitespace, input bounds at 500 characters, and retries retain drafts.
views.mobile: Input and action stay in flow; long words wrap, textarea grows and no fixed tray obscures a keyboard.
views.motion: Ready is static. Accepted receipt does not impose a wait. No writing text moves.
views.copy: Write 3 words. Only the previous line comes with you.

views.composition: A recorded receipt occupies the stage with a calm named status list beneath.
views.hierarchy: Your recorded line is primary; writing, away and watching labels are secondary, not a scoreboard.
views.interaction: Continue explicitly advances the disconnected sketch. Host end-game asks confirmation and returns to lobby without partial reveal.
views.mobile: Receipt and roster stack without crossed-out names or a floating timer.
views.motion: One 180ms receipt settle; no repeating writer pulse or mandatory confirmation delay.
views.copy: Your line is in. Take a breath.

views.composition: An open-seat drawing and direct watching explanation replace the composer inside the stage.
views.hierarchy: Watching this game precedes progress; spectators do not look like overdue active writers.
views.interaction: Preview completed reading order, then join the next game through the usual lobby; no partial reveal or disabled fake input.
views.mobile: One concise notice plus named roster, with natural scrolling.
views.motion: The empty seat stays still; no impatient motion.
views.copy: Pull up a seat. You can write in the next game.

views.composition: A reading-order programme faces a private reading-invitation ticket; the current human reader is the anchor.
views.hierarchy: Current reader, Reveal and read, then reread, step-in and presentation.
views.interaction: An available human can step in; pending/error remain with the read action. Complete poems open together, not line by line.
views.mobile: Reading order and invitation stack before the whole-poem stage; names wrap.
views.motion: Only deliberate reveal gets one 340ms curtain aperture, absent under reduced motion.
views.copy: Let the words have a room.

views.composition: One complete left-aligned poem fills an arch playbill, with the reader named above and actions outside the text.
views.hierarchy: All nine lines at once; current reader and Done remain easy to locate.
views.interaction: Persistent attribution, personal keep, local image save and step-in never animate the poem. Done reaches the private recap; reading order remains available.
views.mobile: The full poem scrolls naturally; narrow verse is not squeezed by icon-only author dots. Long-text fixtures exercise long words and wrapped verse.
views.motion: Only curtain edges move once. Repeated keep, author and reader actions never replay the aperture.
views.copy: A whole poem. A human voice.

views.composition: A focused whole poem sits below a named reader, step-in, Done and Exit controls. Personal save/share utilities stay out of the shared-screen reading composition.
views.hierarchy: All nine sample lines fit the standard 1440×900 shared screen; reader recovery stays above the poem. Waiting and no-ready-poem states do not fabricate hidden text.
views.interaction: Opening a ready poem keeps the shared presentation active. Finish or return to reading order; fallback reading remains deliberate.
views.mobile: Narrow presentation returns to the same single column rather than clipping a landscape canvas.
views.motion: No scrolling recital, moving spotlight, typewriter or autoplay.
views.copy: One poem. One reader. Everyone listening.

views.composition: A private programme collection replaces a podium; readable poem links lead to full replay.
views.hierarchy: Private by default, the complete work, then another game, lobby and exit.
views.interaction: Keep is personal rather than a vote. Whole-set publication has separate disclosure, cancellation and revoke states.
views.mobile: Rows and wrapping actions replace a dense card gallery.
views.motion: No crown, winner burst, applause or celebratory score.
views.copy: Keep the words. Leave the spotlight.

views.composition: An empty arch contains one room-status explanation and a clear way back.
views.hierarchy: Unavailable destination and Join another room; no leaked poem, code or membership detail.
views.interaction: Return to join or Home without pretending an expired room can be restored.
views.mobile: Compact normal-flow stage works at short height and large text.
views.motion: No error stamp, blur or shaking curtain.
views.copy: This room is no longer available.

views.composition: A repair notice stays inside the familiar arch with retained local draft shown separately.
views.hierarchy: What is safe and what to do next: retained words, retry, re-entry.
views.interaction: Retry restores the sketch composer without a fake backend success; Home remains secondary.
views.mobile: Recovery text and actions wrap without overlaying the draft.
views.motion: Immediate repair state, not theatrical failure.
views.copy: The room lost its place. Your words did not.

views.composition: The focused entry arch contains a contextual guest-session status and retry.
views.hierarchy: Guest-first access and recovery precede any account suggestion.
views.interaction: Loading and error are distinct; retry keeps local name and draft. The prototype never claims a real authentication request.
views.mobile: Name and repair text share a single scroll surface.
views.motion: Static busy status, no required spinner.
views.copy: Let’s reconnect your place.

views.composition: An in-flow status strip sits above the writing stage, never across its textarea.
views.hierarchy: Offline, reconnecting or restored text states what happens to the retained draft.
views.interaction: Offline disables sending while retaining typing; restored state removes the blocking wording.
views.mobile: The notice expands the page rather than floating above the keyboard.
views.motion: No reconnect pulse; text communicates the state in silence.
views.copy: Offline. Your draft stays in this tab.

views.composition: A quiet persistent edition notice sits above ordinary page content with Reload.
views.hierarchy: Detected update and voluntary action; normal network failure is not called stale.
views.interaction: Healthy omits the notice. The sketch reload action does not discard an in-memory draft.
views.mobile: Text and reload wrap in ordinary document flow.
views.motion: No forced refresh, countdown or animation masking latency.
views.copy: A new edition is ready. Reload when you can.

views.composition: A personal playbill shelf uses wide readable poem rows and modest collection facts.
views.hierarchy: Poems and private status precede factual totals; no dashboard KPI cards.
views.interaction: Open, personal keep and explicit public-link revoke are separate; guest copy explains browser limits.
views.mobile: One column on phones; first lines and long names wrap without hover-dependent actions.
views.motion: No staggered entry or lifted hover cards; Open poem always shows.
views.copy: Your little collection.

views.composition: A complete saved playbill has an archive breadcrumb and independent permission strip.
views.hierarchy: The poem comes before sharing; private save and public linking have different verbs.
views.interaction: Attribution persists, local image/print are private, and public revoke remains independently actionable.
views.mobile: All actions sit below the text, not on top of narrow lines.
views.motion: Rereading has no ceremony; no timed author tooltip.
views.copy: A poem to come back to.

views.composition: Authorized public poems receive a clean guest playbill; unavailable links receive a neutral empty arch with no snippets.
views.hierarchy: The permission state gates the whole poem and all attribution.
views.interaction: Public view offers save/print but no participant keep or revoke; pending, private, expired and revoked states reveal nothing.
views.mobile: Same responsive full-poem measure; unavailable state is concise.
views.motion: No pretend progress or blurred private preview.
views.copy: This poem is private or no longer available.

views.composition: An inline playbill disclosure explains whole-poem public scope before delivery-state controls.
views.hierarchy: All lines and attribution would become readable; private image saving remains a different action.
views.interaction: Local consent, delivery, cancellation, activation failure and revoke are explicit simulations. Native OS share chrome is never imitated.
views.mobile: Disclosure comes before full-width choices; no cramped modal keyboard overlap.
views.motion: Status wording changes in place; no success stamp before activation.
views.copy: Anyone with the link could read this whole poem.

views.composition: A whole-programme disclosure makes the full-set publication scope explicit.
views.hierarchy: Every poem and contributor, not only the currently viewed work.
views.interaction: Cancellation remains private. Local success/revoke demonstrate reversibility without network publication.
views.mobile: Scope precedes choices in one readable column.
views.motion: No share reward, social burst or theatrical fan-out.
views.copy: Share the whole evening, only if everyone is comfortable.

views.composition: The whole poem becomes an arch-topped local PNG with restrained Linejam identity and full attribution.
views.hierarchy: All nine lines, author names and readable contrast; no exported action buttons.
views.interaction: Actual local canvas download uses the selected palette and height derived from wrapped words/names. It never publishes a URL.
views.mobile: Screen preview scales while the real image remains 1200px wide and grows vertically.
views.motion: Stable saving and error feedback, no delay.
views.copy: Save an image. Keep it private.

views.composition: Plain ink on white with every line and full attribution; stage ornament reduces to a simple document.
views.hierarchy: Poem first; navigation, utilities and artwork do not print.
views.interaction: Explicit Print invokes the real browser dialog. The OS owns accept, cancel and destination.
views.mobile: Screen preview is readable on a phone; print has no clipped fixed-height poem region.
views.motion: Static document, no animation.
views.copy: A paper copy of the whole poem.

views.composition: A public programme contains complete poem articles, each retaining reader and attribution context.
views.hierarchy: Public scope and entire works precede join/new-room promotion.
views.interaction: Unavailable state suppresses all content. Real browser print includes the complete sample set, not only one selected card.
views.mobile: Full poems stack on phones; columns appear only when readable.
views.motion: No motion while reading or printing a collection.
views.copy: The poems from this room.

views.composition: A calm account-entry arch sits beside an optional clearly synthetic sample playbill on desktop.
views.hierarchy: Optional cross-device keeping benefit; guest play remains available.
views.interaction: Provider-managed form styling, verification and error are labelled previews. Local mode says Accounts are not connected; nothing is authenticated.
views.mobile: Form first; showcase omitted on narrow screens.
views.motion: No identity-performance animation.
views.copy: Your poems, between devices.

views.composition: The same account arch uses creation wording and a visible guest alternative.
views.hierarchy: Account benefit does not become a play gate or compulsory avatar choice.
views.interaction: Preview verification without sending or storing credentials; no fake account success.
views.mobile: Labels and touch-sized fields remain reachable with text scaling.
views.motion: Stable immediate form states.
views.copy: Keep coming back.

views.composition: A compact transfer-status playbill frames guest-progress safety as the outcome.
views.hierarchy: Completing, unavailable and migration failure are distinct.
views.interaction: Retry and Go home never erase locally typed words. A success treatment is labelled as a preview, not real migration.
views.mobile: Concise status expands for errors in document flow.
views.motion: Static busy wording instead of an endless spinner.
views.copy: Bringing your guest poems with you.

views.composition: An original cameo and ordinary pen name lead a modest personal identity stage.
views.hierarchy: Name is primary; account or browser-only facts are secondary, with no public status theatre.
views.interaction: Name and cameo change locally; guest and signed-in treatments stay truthful and separate.
views.mobile: Long names wrap; no compulsory photo or miniature color-dot identity.
views.motion: No grayscale-to-color hover transformation.
views.copy: The name your room knows.

views.composition: A compact account-treatment panel opens with plain management and sign-out verbs.
views.hierarchy: Provider-owned account controls sit outside the game; local guest mode never impersonates authentication.
views.interaction: Manage-account opens a labelled design treatment; Escape restores focus. Sign-out only changes local preview state.
views.mobile: Bounded scrollable panel, native controls and large text.
views.motion: No floating panel entrance.
views.copy: Your account, outside the game.

views.composition: A short programme dialog gives the truthful nine-count arc and three literal rules.
views.hierarchy: Write a line, see only the previous line, read all completed lines together.
views.interaction: Close, Got it, Escape and backdrop all close; focus trap, scroll lock and focus restoration are implemented.
views.mobile: Short-height dialog scrolls without hiding its close action.
views.motion: Immediate dialog, no instructional fade-up.
views.copy: Nine lines. One unexpected poem.

views.composition: A practical settings playbill offers native daylight/evening/system radios, reduced motion, optional sound and cameos.
views.hierarchy: Readable palette first; sensory choices independent and optional.
views.interaction: System preference is honored. Explicit reduce can only reduce further. Sound begins off and requires activation before a cue.
views.mobile: Touch-sized labels and bounded scrolling instead of icon-only palette dots.
views.motion: Palette changes immediately, without a global color wash.
views.copy: Daylight or evening. Same little room.

views.composition: A quiet chronological programme page leads with plain product copy and native technical disclosure.
views.hierarchy: Version/date and user-facing changes precede grouped details.
views.interaction: Sample release content is explicitly synthetic; Home and sample RSS preview remain linked.
views.mobile: One comfortable column; no decorative timeline.
views.motion: Native details opens without animated height.
views.copy: What changed in the room.

views.composition: A plain RSS artifact preview shows title, description and sample entry without fake reader chrome.
views.hierarchy: Actual feed fields, clearly labelled synthetic rather than real product history.
views.interaction: Download a local sample RSS XML document. External feed readers are not emulated.
views.mobile: Long source lines wrap and full text remains downloadable.
views.motion: No motion or tracking.
views.copy: In your own reader.

views.composition: An empty miniature arch and human-sized 404 explanation replace a giant error stamp.
views.hierarchy: What happened and Return home are the hierarchy.
views.interaction: Safe return without revealing guessed destination details.
views.mobile: Normal document flow, not a fixed full-screen overlay.
views.motion: No error theatrics.
views.copy: Nothing is playing at this address.

views.composition: The familiar arch holds a concise repair state and native recovery controls.
views.hierarchy: Try again, then Home, with local draft safety explicit.
views.interaction: Recovery opens the retained draft without pretending a server repair occurred.
views.mobile: Readable copy and wrapping controls at narrow widths.
views.motion: Immediate error; no content shake.
views.copy: This page lost its place.

views.composition: A minimal standalone recovery composition keeps fallback colors and ordinary typography.
views.hierarchy: Application failure and the safe next action survive without illustration or providers.
views.interaction: Native recovery controls do not rely on audio, motion or account context.
views.mobile: No fixed overlay or tiny type; normal page flow survives text zoom.
views.motion: No runtime animation dependency.
views.copy: Linejam could not open this page.

views.composition: A light programme-cover artwork pairs the original curtain-line mark with a short invitation and truthful count arc.
views.hierarchy: Linejam and collaborative poetry stay readable at thumbnail size; no private room data.
views.interaction: Static original artwork, not an interactive miniature or backend screenshot.
views.mobile: Responsive specimen keeps the artwork legible and surrounding controls separate.
views.motion: Static by definition.
views.copy: A little room. An unexpected poem.

views.composition: An authorized public teaser fills a light arch card; private, pending or revoked uses generic brand only.
views.hierarchy: Public scope before teaser. No faint private text or hidden contributor leakage.
views.interaction: Explicit permission-state selector demonstrates the boundary without creating a public link.
views.mobile: Long teasers wrap; full private export remains a separate complete artifact.
views.motion: Static by definition.
views.copy: A poem made together.

views.composition: A light programme cover contains two authorized teaser columns and a clear whole-session title.
views.hierarchy: Collection identity and public scope precede fragments; unavailable is generic brand only.
views.interaction: State preview never activates publication or borrows private content.
views.mobile: Specimen stacks or scales cleanly without clipping surrounding navigation.
views.motion: Static by definition.
views.copy: The poems from this room.

components.treatment: One semantic theatre shell, original curtain mark, local fonts, two explicit palettes and persistent sketch provenance.
components.states: Guest and account preview variants share navigation; focused game chrome contracts rather than hiding recovery.
components.accessibility: Skip link, main landmark, natural scroll and native controls work without motion, audio or remote services.

components.treatment: Curtain-line wordmark at left; Library, Help, Appearance and ordinary name utilities at right.
components.states: Compact wrapping utilities retain labels in guest/account and narrow states; overlays restore their trigger focus.
components.accessibility: No essential icon-only navigation or hover-only menu.

components.treatment: A quiet closing programme rule with Home, privacy context and exploration exit.
components.states: Navigation remains separate from the active writing action; print removes footer.
components.accessibility: Wrapping text links and visible focus do not rely on decoration.

components.treatment: Large left invitation and one illustrated curtain aperture; two explicit entry buttons beneath.
components.states: First visit and returning collection state change helper copy, not the primary action locations.
components.accessibility: Actions remain in document flow, reachable with text zoom and touch.

components.treatment: Name form inside one intimate arch, optional cameos below the name.
components.states: Empty, pending and error remain on the same form with the typed name intact.
components.accessibility: Visible label, inline error, native submit and no compulsory avatar.

components.treatment: Invitation ticket joins a code/name form without an account detour.
components.states: Manual, read-only invite, loading, full-room and retry states retain destination context.
components.accessibility: Code Enter advances to the name; read-only is explained in text.

components.treatment: Room phase is a single stage owner, with concise room identity and phase-specific contents.
components.states: Lobby, writing, waiting, reveal and unavailable each have an actual composition; no card summarizing a hidden phase.
components.accessibility: Phase focus moves to the scene heading only after a deliberate navigation.

components.treatment: An empty arch with a direct safe exit rather than displaying unrecognized room data.
components.states: Unexpected state gives Home and Rejoin without exposing prior poem text.
components.accessibility: Plain text recovery, no visual-code dependence.

components.treatment: A named cast strip and one perforated gold invitation ticket frame the host’s start area.
components.states: One-person minimum, full cast, participant waiting, away and mutation error all retain visible names.
components.accessibility: No ranked or crossed-out roster; room capacity and ownership are words.

components.treatment: Quiet stage holds either the real composer, receipt or explicit spectator explanation.
components.states: Assignment loading, assigned writing, already recorded and no-assignment states do not expose other lines.
components.accessibility: A single labelled textarea when entitled to write; no disabled imitation for spectators.

components.treatment: One previous line, one large textarea and an honest count form a single visual unit.
components.states: Below/exact/over target, restored draft, sending, accepted, retry and offline are on-surface states; input caps at 500 characters.
components.accessibility: Whitespace count, long-word wrapping and aria-described inline guidance; no per-keystroke sound.

components.treatment: Recorded receipt above a cast status list, with no pressure pulse.
components.states: Loading, some recorded, all ready, away and spectator labels are plain language; host abandon is confirmed.
components.accessibility: Names remain full contrast and spectators are explicitly excluded from active count.

components.treatment: A running-order playbill with a private read invitation and named current reader.
components.states: Ready, pending, error, fallback reader, reread and all-read states have corresponding explicit actions.
components.accessibility: Step in is human-controlled; no autoplay or mandatory speaking.

components.treatment: A whole-poem arch playbill; attribution and actions sit outside the quiet text column.
components.states: Reveal, archive, public and reread preserve all lines; author details persist until closed; sharing and saving differ.
components.accessibility: Semantic ordered full text, no timed author tooltip and no text transforms.

components.treatment: A private programme collection, never a crown podium.
components.states: No-favorite and favorite states only change your personal keep control; rematch, lobby and exit stay explicit.
components.accessibility: No competition, social winner or audio burst; private scope stated before publication.

components.treatment: A scalable arch with a clear title, named reader and persistent Exit presentation.
components.states: Lobby and reveal presentation reuse the phone hierarchy at larger type size.
components.accessibility: Natural scroll, no forced fullscreen or fixed clipped poem region.

components.treatment: An enlarged invitation playbill with the complete cast alongside.
components.states: Just joined and away use text; room full remains calm; exit returns to lobby.
components.accessibility: Not dependent on a TV, QR scanning or an anonymous colored dot.

components.treatment: Invitation destination and plain Open invitation action are the primary accessible route.
components.states: An original QR specimen actually encodes only LINEJAM DESIGN SKETCH; it is explicitly labelled as text, not a live invitation. Open invitation and copied sketch token are working local alternatives.
components.accessibility: Readable destination, copy recovery and precise QR alt text; no invented valid room code or fake live barcode.

components.treatment: One focused full poem and human reader; running order below rather than stacked competing poems.
components.states: Waiting, ready, revealing, error, reread and finish states stay in the same stage.

components.treatment: A small Appearance control on the name-entry stage opens the same bounded settings panel.

components.states: Featured means a larger first line, not rotation; personal keep and revoke expose pending and failure text.
components.accessibility: Keyboard/touch see the same controls as pointer hover; long titles wrap.

components.treatment: A still arch-shaped placeholder reserving the poem row’s approximate dimensions.
components.states: Loading text announces once; no six-card independent shimmer.
components.accessibility: Hidden shapes and visible status label avoid meaningless repeated announcements.

components.treatment: An empty stage and direct Start or Join actions, with no invented poem fragments.
components.states: Empty guest and account variants explain where future completed poems will appear.
components.accessibility: No gray ghost content that could be mistaken for an inaccessible poem.

components.treatment: The true nine-count arc is rendered as static widths/heights with the literal count sequence.
components.states: Small/medium/large variants retain the same truth; empty state stays still.
components.accessibility: A full accessible pattern label accompanies decorative geometry.

components.treatment: Unused compact source variant is retired in favor of the same readable static count arc.
components.states: Showcase explicitly labels this retirement and demonstrates the replacement, not a hidden implementation.
components.accessibility: One labelled rule visualization rather than duplicate inaccessible miniatures.

components.treatment: Distinct cameo silhouettes with visible human names replace color-only dots.
components.states: Up to a small inline group followed by a labelled Show all contributors control; expanded list remains open.
components.accessibility: Color is optional; names and silhouettes survive grayscale.

components.treatment: Unused inline gradient underline is retired; ordinary named attribution is the proposed replacement.
components.states: Empty attribution says nothing invented; selected attribution is persistent text.
components.accessibility: No hover-only identity or anonymous Contributor N labels.

components.treatment: Archive/public detail owns one full playbill and an independent permission strip.
components.states: Loading, public pending, authorized, private and revoked do not share leaked teaser markup.
components.accessibility: Outsiders have no participant keep or revoke controls.

components.treatment: Complete poems are individual programme articles with their own reader and attribution.
components.states: Public and unavailable states are separate; every authorized poem is included in print.
components.accessibility: No partial print clipping; native document flow and headings.

components.treatment: Plain Print or save PDF button outside the poem articles.
components.states: Invokes real browser print on click; browser owns accept/cancel and destination.
components.accessibility: No fake custom operating-system export dialog; hidden in print.

components.treatment: One quiet account-entry arch; synthetic/public sample playbill at desktop right only.
components.states: Form first on mobile; disconnected local mode replaces provider interaction truthfully.
components.accessibility: Guest play is always available and decorative showcase is not required to understand entry.

components.treatment: Provider-form visual treatment with optional sign-in purpose and guest exit.
components.states: Integrated-form sketch, verification, recovery and accounts-unavailable states are labelled, not live authentication.
components.accessibility: No credentials leave the prototype or are stored.

components.treatment: Account-creation treatment shares the same calm arch and optional guest route.
components.states: Creation preview, verification and error retain field space; local mode has no pretend account success.
components.accessibility: Large text and native labels; no required photo or display identity performance.

components.treatment: Guest-progress transfer status becomes a concise playbill.
components.states: Completing, migration error, retry and local unavailability preserve in-memory game text.
components.accessibility: Status wording says what is safe; no spinner required.

components.treatment: A clearly synthetic sample whole-poem playbill, never borrowed public user text.
components.states: Pending/empty sample state stays labeled; explicitly public production source would be separately authorized.
components.accessibility: Showcase is optional and omitted on phones; no stock or provider imagery dependency.

components.treatment: Cameo plus ordinary pen name above modest guest/account facts.
components.states: Guest, integrated account and disconnected local modes have truthful different copy.
components.accessibility: Full names wrap; optional avatar never replaces the accessible name.

components.treatment: Simple chronological programme notes with product copy before technical detail.
components.states: Empty and loaded examples are explicitly synthetic sketch content.
components.accessibility: Native disclosure and readable linked headings; no animated timeline.

components.treatment: Version/date sit above one product-note paragraph and a technical disclosure.
components.states: No card stack effect; collapsed and expanded detail reserve ordinary document flow.
components.accessibility: Semantic heading/time/detail without reliance on tiny metadata.

components.treatment: Native details/summary section groups technical changes beneath the product note.
components.states: Closed and open are actual interactive disclosure states.
components.accessibility: Keyboard Enter/Space, no animated height, no hidden copy on focus.

components.treatment: Quiet empty arch and direct return action instead of a giant 404 stamp.
components.states: Missing routes and unavailable recap reveal no content.
components.accessibility: No motion, grain or fixed overlay requirement for recovery.

components.treatment: Familiar repair arch with Retry and Home.
components.states: Failure and retry feedback preserve a readable scene and draft safety.
components.accessibility: Native controls work in silent/reduced modes.

components.treatment: Minimal standalone recovery surface with fallback serif/sans and direct text.
components.states: Works as a document-level composition even when other runtime styling is absent.
components.accessibility: No dependency on custom image, sound, focus manager or provider.

components.treatment: Warm-gold primary with dark plum text; outlined secondary, quiet textual utility and explicit rose danger.
components.states: Hover uses an inset outline; press is at most one pixel; disabled and pending carry readable labels.
components.accessibility: Minimum 44px target, 3px focus outline; reduced motion removes press movement.

components.treatment: Plain labelled plum-paper field with a stable border and generous line height.
components.states: Empty, filled, focused, disabled, read-only and invalid differ through text/border semantics.
components.accessibility: Native label, described help, error association and long-text containment.

components.treatment: Sentence-case DM Sans labels, not tracked uppercase monospace.
components.states: Required word target can use modest weight; explanatory labels remain normal human language.
components.accessibility: Programmatically associated labels do not rely on placeholder text.

components.treatment: A colored left-edge notice with title, reason and nearby recovery action.
components.states: Error/success/warning/info all differ in language as well as accent.
components.accessibility: Status versus alert semantics fit urgency; no disappearing only-copy.

components.treatment: Original oval, fan, moon and plume cameos with distinct inner silhouettes; pen names remain primary.
components.states: Optional selection, absent cameo, host and reader states never change a person’s name.
components.accessibility: 44px or larger meaningful cameo showcase; no color-only identification.

components.treatment: A small textual Host label replaces a crown to separate responsibility from rank.
components.states: Light/dark and transferred host states preserve clear ownership wording.
components.accessibility: No royal/favorite symbolism or color-only status.

components.treatment: A still curtain-line mark and contextual Preparing text.
components.states: Room, join, reveal and account operations identify the awaited outcome; no fake numerical progress.
components.accessibility: One polite aria-busy region; motion never required.

components.treatment: A quiet soft-pacing line with Take your time copy; no timer-shaped badge.
components.states: Warm/overtime are nonblocking text states; absent start omits pacing.
components.accessibility: Never announces a ticking countdown or gates valid submission.

components.treatment: A 160ms cameo settle replaces rotated stamping; words are never inside the animated wrapper.
components.states: Arrival and acknowledgement trigger once, with no staggered hidden names.
components.accessibility: Reduced motion is immediate, no residual animation delay.

components.treatment: A small row of discrete count marks below the actual textarea, without duplicating every typed word as tiles.
components.states: Below/exact/over target is a literal count with Add/Remove words guidance; overflow is summarized rather than creating ten noisy tiles.
components.accessibility: One debounced count announcement, long words stay in textarea and input is not visually fragmented.

components.treatment: Keep privately is a labelled toggle, not a vote or reaction score.
components.states: Unkept/kept/pending/error use aria-pressed and visible feedback; failure restores previous value.
components.accessibility: No silent logged-only failure, reward animation or hover-only heart label.

components.treatment: Light arch artwork with original mark and truthful nine-count pattern.
components.states: Fallback fonts retain hierarchy and no private data is present.
components.accessibility: High-contrast large title and simple silhouette survive thumbnail/grayscale.

components.treatment: Authorized public teaser on a light playbill with a clear shared-poem label.
components.states: Long teaser truncation is intentional for social preview only, never full download.
components.accessibility: Private/pending/revoked uses separate generic artwork.

components.treatment: Generic curtain-line brand and invitation, containing no poem or contributor data.
components.states: Same safe composition for unavailable, pending and private.
components.accessibility: No faint or blurred private text masquerading as privacy.

components.treatment: Whole-poem, full-attribution image with restrained arch rule and no embedded app controls.
components.states: Local PNG honors light/dark and derives height from all wrapped lines and names.
components.accessibility: No clipping; readable type and high-contrast ink/gold pairing.

components.treatment: Programme-cover artwork with up to two authorized teaser columns.
components.states: Public artwork is distinct from generic unavailable fallback; no private count or author leak.
components.accessibility: Large readable heading and high-contrast static composition.

motion.choreography: Aperture and cameo settle disappear entirely; all content is already present and ordered.
motion.timing: Immediate under OS reduce or the explicit reduce override.
motion.reducedMotion: No residual delays, transforms, smooth scrolling or hidden starting opacity.

motion.choreography: Replace the global color wash with an immediate palette change and native checked radio state.
motion.timing: 0ms, including first paint.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical immediate state; no special alternate skin.

motion.choreography: Keep the writing action in normal document flow and focus the textarea only by deliberate action.
motion.timing: Functional reflow only; no interpolated viewport motion.
motion.reducedMotion: Same keyboard-safe geometry and automatic nearest scrolling.

motion.choreography: Manual focus brings the composer into the nearest visible area; round change focuses the new heading without smooth travel.
motion.timing: Immediate auto scroll; no decorative delay.

motion.choreography: An inset outline and optional one-pixel physical press acknowledge touch; no large scale crush.
motion.timing: 90–120ms only while actively pressing.
motion.reducedMotion: Remove the transform; border and focus still change.

motion.choreography: One cameo moves down 5px and settles; its human name never enters an opacity-zero wrapper.
motion.timing: 160ms once, no player-index delay.
motion.reducedMotion: Cameo and name both appear immediately.

motion.choreography: Static status text and still reserved-size silhouettes replace independent pulses and spinners.
motion.timing: No repeating animation; state changes only when the sketch control is used.

motion.choreography: Retire routine fade-up entrances; the one memorable entrance belongs to completed-poem curtain edges.
motion.timing: 0ms for forms, notices, archive and errors.

motion.choreography: Underline Open poem and show an inset border on focus/hover; no lifted cards or hidden badges.
motion.timing: Immediate hover/focus state; no stagger.

motion.choreography: Keep the nine-count arc fully drawn; no hover-triggered bar growth.
motion.timing: Static on first paint and replay.

motion.choreography: Click a named contributor control to reveal persistent attribution below the poem, without moving poem lines.
motion.timing: Immediate; stays open until dismissed.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical text disclosure; no hover dependence.

motion.choreography: Remove the endless writer pulse and struck-through names; a plain Recorded/Writing/Away label carries presence.
motion.timing: No repeated animation.

motion.choreography: Soft pacing changes a quiet line and helper text; overtime says there is no cut-off.
motion.timing: Discrete state preview; no countdown announcement or urgency loop.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate nonblocking state with no interpolation.

motion.choreography: Count marks and Add/Remove guidance update next to the textarea; ready is a stable accepted color and text.
motion.timing: Visual state immediate; spoken count debounced 500ms.
motion.reducedMotion: Same count semantics and no animated fill.

motion.choreography: Retire the ready pulse. Exact count enables a still Submit line button and says Ready to send.
motion.timing: No idle loop or repeated nudge.

motion.choreography: After explicit successful local commit, one receipt mark settles while accepted wording and the saved line are immediately readable.
motion.timing: 180ms visual acknowledgement; Continue is available immediately, with no mandatory 1500ms wait.
motion.reducedMotion: Receipt appears immediately; manual continuation unchanged.

motion.choreography: Show authors as a persistent labelled text section; no 2-second tooltip or moving text.
motion.timing: Immediate open/close controlled by reader.

motion.choreography: Programme dialog mounts immediately, traps focus, locks background scroll and restores its trigger on close.
motion.timing: 0ms; lifecycle not animation-dependent.

motion.choreography: Tools/appearance open immediately and retain their triggering focus context.
motion.timing: 0ms, Escape and outside dismissal immediate.
motion.reducedMotion: Same bounded panel and native selected state.

motion.choreography: A single movement along ten-pixel curtain edges accompanies the already-visible complete poem; focus lands on the reader heading, never an individual line.
motion.timing: 340ms maximum, triggered by deliberate reveal; no masked words, delayed content mounting or waiting before controls are available.
motion.reducedMotion: Curtains do not render motion; whole poem and focus appear immediately.

motion.choreography: One cameo settles and Just joined text appears; the named status remains until the next deliberate preview state.
motion.timing: 160ms cameo, persistent textual arrival context.

motion.choreography: Remove crown, winner and burst. Keep privately changes only a personal collection state.
motion.timing: Immediate toggle; no applause, ranked leader or ceremony.

motion.choreography: Explicit sound activation permits one warm bell only when Play cue or a deliberate reader invitation is pressed.
motion.timing: A 380ms bounded two-partial envelope; no recurring events.
motion.reducedMotion: Sound still separately opt-in; silence is complete. No haptics are used.

motion.choreography: Remove grayscale/color filters; cameo or optional provider image remains visually stable.
motion.timing: Static.

motion.choreography: Do not carry typewriter, breathing or final-line wipe definitions into this direction; the full poem preview stays still.
motion.timing: No mounted effect or dead animation dependency.

sensory.treatment: Pocket theatre, not luxury lounge: plum paper, a generous arch and ordinary human verbs; one curtain-line signature.
sensory.controls: Daylight/evening modes and explicit reduced motion; guest first.
sensory.risk: Theatre can make shy writers feel observed; quiet writing, unranked cast and easy human step-in counter that.

sensory.treatment: Original inline SVG joins an open pair of curtains and a single carried line; DM Serif Linejam stays readable in monochrome.
sensory.controls: Artwork preview includes small/large and both palette contexts.
sensory.risk: No borrowed stage logo, casino gold border or illegible ligature.

sensory.treatment: The curtain-line mark fits a simple plum square with lavender geometry and a light companion; no tiny wordmark inside an icon.
sensory.controls: Static app-icon, browser-size and installation-size previews; no installation or manifest mutation.
sensory.risk: Small-size recognition depends on the silhouette rather than color or detail.

sensory.treatment: Plain plum paper with a single restrained stage shadow and two arch edges; no grain, blur or background gradient.
sensory.controls: Both modes are intentionally drawn, not inverted.
sensory.risk: Too much gilding reads formal; gold is confined to the main action and invitation.

sensory.treatment: DM Serif Display for invitation and complete poem, DM Sans for names, labels, counts and controls; local licensed fonts only.
sensory.controls: Type specimen includes long words, readable body text and large-text-friendly wrapping.
sensory.risk: Serif poem type needs generous line-height and width; no tiny all-caps theatre metadata.

sensory.treatment: Original oval, fan, moon and plume cameo silhouettes with optional stage-color accent; visible names remain the identity.
sensory.controls: Optional cameo selection and name-only choice, no photos needed.
sensory.risk: Cameos are not costumes, genders or performance roles; nobody must customize to join.

sensory.treatment: An arch-like rise and fall literally displays 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1; the poem itself remains left aligned.
sensory.controls: Static labelled diagram and actual count interaction, no word prompts.
sensory.risk: Avoid making the count arc look like scoring, an audio meter or a countdown.

sensory.treatment: A consistent original two-pixel line vocabulary for curtain, bell, keep, print, archive and help, always paired with words.
sensory.controls: Visible labels and accessible names; no emoji substitutions.
sensory.risk: Decorative symbols never substitute for privacy, authority or recovery text.

sensory.treatment: An original warm bell made from 392Hz and 784Hz sine partials with a soft attack and 380ms decay; no music or applause.
sensory.controls: Defaults OFF; Enable sound then Play cue required. Stop/disable is explicit; context is created only after activation.
sensory.risk: Sound can compete with a human reader; short, low gain and never required to know whose turn it is.

sensory.treatment: No vibration patterns in this direction. A visible reader-name change and recorded receipt are the entire acknowledgement.
sensory.controls: Sound remains independently optional; no navigator.vibrate call or device dependency.
sensory.risk: Haptics add surprise and pressure without explaining the poem; omission is intentional.

sensory.treatment: Distinct generic brand preview, authorized public teaser, complete privately saved image and whole-session programme artwork.
sensory.controls: Explicit public/private state previews and a real local full-poem PNG download.
sensory.risk: Never leak private lines into fallback previews; full author names survive image/print output.

sensory.treatment: Labelled Share, Save image and Print controls hand off to native capabilities only after consent; OS chrome is not drawn.
sensory.controls: The sketch exposes local delivery/cancel/error states, actual local PNG and real print on click; no network publication.
sensory.risk: Native cancellation is not an error or evidence of publication. Local files are not public links.

sensory.treatment: A clearly synthetic nine-line sample playbill sits beside the optional account form; provider imagery is not invented.
sensory.controls: Hide showcase on phones and allow name-only identity; no external assets.
sensory.risk: Public source authorization must remain separate from account marketing; sample fixture is not real human gameplay evidence.
